open_targets.why: Untappd 5.0 (2026-10-15) and Vivino's 2026 rebuild both made personal drink logging worse for long-time users; on the watchlist at 3.55
open_targets.evidence: 88 low-star reviews in 90d, 87 of them on v5.0.x since 2026-10-16 (us 66, gb 21); before v5 only 1 in 2+ months. Themes: UI/clutter 48, friends feed 17, own history/tracking 12, ads 10, Insider/paywall 7. Kill check: personal beer journals are tiny (Beerstory 0 ratings, Tastings 3, BrewGene 75, Pint Please 35), but Bruwia is free, no subscription, and already imports Untappd history (takeoutday.org guide, 2026-10-15). Untappd's own check-in export is Insider-only (GDPR request in EU). Round 3 added Vivino: ~15 of its 25 low-star reviews (us, gb, Aug–Oct 2026) are about the rebuild breaking manual entry, editing and saved tastings. Off-store searches (round 4) found no Reddit/forum threads, only press about 5.0 (thebeertimes.com, 2026-10-15). 2026-11-03 rescan: Untappd 91 low-star in 90d (us 69, gb 22), now on 5.0.2; Vivino 26 (us 20, gb 6). 2026-11-04 rescan: Untappd 92 in 90d, tapering to 1-6 a day by 10-31, Vivino 27; no new storefronts, no Reddit or forum threads (one more search round)
open_targets.missing: persistence: rescan both in about a week and count new low-star reviews on v5.1+ / 2026.44+ (needs ≥15 in the newer versions); other storefronts (the targeted pool can't reach ca/au/de/nl for apps that chart only in us/gb, so ca/au evidence needs the pool fix or WebFetch of public review pages); ≥3 off-store threads (none found by search on 2026-11-02); willingness to pay (asks for a paid private journal, or Insider/Premium cancellations citing logging); Bruwia's App Store rating count
